content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "The \"Ishan Uday\" Special Scholarship Scheme For North Eastern Region is a central sector scholarship scheme implemented by the University Grants Commission (UGC) under the Ministry of Education [E01]. It aims to promote higher education in the North Eastern Region by providing equal opportunities for higher studies, increasing the Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER), and focusing on professional education [E01]. The scheme offers 10,000 fresh scholarships annually for general degree courses and technical/professional courses including medical and paramedical courses [E01]. Scholarship amounts are ₹5,400 per month for general degree courses and ₹7,800 per month for technical/medical/professional/paramedical courses, paid through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) [E01]. Eligibility requires applicants to be domiciles of the North Eastern Region with parental annual income not exceeding ₹4,50,000, and to have passed Class 12th in the preceding year [E03]. The scheme excludes students pursuing open university courses, those already receiving scholarships, those admitted through management quota, and diploma course students [E01].
